mods.name: Babekon's Morph Mod
mods.description: Transform into any mob you've killed! Collect souls and gain their abilities. Öldürdüğün her mob'a dönüş!

releases.notes:
### 🎭 Babekon's Morph Mod
Have you ever wanted to soar through the skies as an Ender Dragon, walk through solid blocks like a Vex, sneak through tight spaces as a Silverfish, or unleash devastation as the Warden?

Babekon's Morph Mod brings the ultimate shape-shifting experience to modern Minecraft. Defeat any creature in your world to claim its soul, open an interactive 3D menu, and instantly transform—gaining not just their appearance, but their real stats, animations, and active abilities!

### ✨ Key Features

- 👻 Soul Collection: Whenever you defeat a mob for the first time, its soul is drawn to you and permanently added to your morph collection.

- 🖥️ Interactive 3D Morph Menu (- Key): Browse all your unlocked morphs in an intuitive Minecraft-style inventory GUI with live 3D animated models, category filters, and an instant search bar.

- 📏 Dynamic Scaling & Camera: Whether you transform into a tiny bee or a colossal iron golem, your hitbox, eye height, and third-person camera automatically and smoothly adapt to the mob's size.

- 🎬 Living Animations: Full custom and vanilla animation support—from bats flapping their wings, axolotls playing dead, camels doing high-speed dashes, to armadillos curling into a ball.

### ⚡ Unique Active Abilities (G & H Keys)
Almost every mob comes with dedicated active and secondary abilities:

- 💥 Creeper: Prime and explode on command!

- 🌀 Enderman: Teleport precisely to where you are aiming.

- 👻 Vex: Phase freely through solid blocks and walls.

- 🔥 Blaze: Hover in mid-air and shoot rapid fireballs.

- 🪽 Phantom: Seamless elytra-style flight with an explosive rocket boost!

- 🐙 Squid & Glow Squid: Blind nearby enemies with an ink cloud dash.

- 🔊 Warden: Charge up and fire a destructive Sonic Boom!

- 🛡️ Iron Golem & Shulker: Shield slam enemies into the air, or close your shell for impenetrable defense.

- 🧙 Witch & Evoker: Cast real lingering splash potions and summon snapping fangs from the ground.
